framework_lessons: Separate operational resilience from valuation and returns.
assessment: Tariff pass-through and volatility cautions were useful. The explicit eighteen-month bitcoin call was wrong at maturity. Adobe illustrates the gap between growing earnings and successful equity returns, while ITUB supported the dated Brazil rebound. El Salvador reserve purchases and Lightning deployment require more careful distinctions than headline wallet balances or announcements.
